credentials.description: Home Assistant base URL, e.g. https://home.example.com
credentials.help: The address you open Home Assistant at in a browser, with http(s):// and the port if it has one.
credentials.label: Address
credentials.name: host
credentials.rule: Only an address an admin has allowed for this service.

credentials.label: Access token
credentials.name: token

addons.description: Lights, devices and the TV, reminders when you arrive or get in the car
examples: Turn off the living room lights
Remind me to take out the trash when I get home
features: Turn lights, the AC, gates and other devices on and off
Reminders when you arrive at a place, leave it or get in the car
Knows which devices are in which room
The weather for your morning briefing
addons.name: homeassistant

needs.what: a Home Assistant server Dana's server can reach
needs.why: Lights, devices, zones and the weather come from it

needs.what: a Home Assistant long-lived access token
needs.why: Dana signs in to Home Assistant with it
Arrive, leave, car and wake reminders use its sensors

settings.description: The user's person entity: zone enter / leave triggers
settings.help: Your person in Home Assistant (Settings → People), for reminders when you arrive or leave.
settings.label: You in Home Assistant
settings.name: person

settings.description: The phone's Bluetooth connection sensor: car enter / leave triggers
settings.help: From the Home Assistant phone app, for reminders when you get in the car.
settings.label: Phone's Bluetooth sensor
settings.name: car_sensor

settings.description: The car's Bluetooth name, as it shows in that sensor's connected_paired_devices
settings.help: The name your car has in your phone's Bluetooth list.
settings.label: Car's Bluetooth name
settings.name: car_device

settings.description: Phone screen-on (interactive) binary sensor: confirms the wake signal
settings.help: From the Home Assistant phone app; tells Dana you are awake.
settings.label: Phone's screen-on sensor
settings.name: phone_interactive_sensor

settings.description: Phone battery level sensor (a dashboard's Batteries widget when it names none)
settings.help: From the Home Assistant phone app; shown on dashboards.
settings.label: Phone's battery sensor
settings.name: phone_battery_sensor

settings.description: The phone's mobile_app notify service suffix (reported by /api/client-config)
settings.help: Set by the Dana phone app; change it only if it is wrong.
settings.label: Phone's notify service
settings.name: phone_notify_service

settings.description: Weather entity for the wake briefing and the Now screen
settings.help: The weather entity your forecast comes from (Settings → Devices & services).
settings.label: Weather
settings.name: weather_entity

settings.description: Android TV media_player entity (the androidtv / ADB one) the TV tool controls by default
settings.help: Your Android TV's media player (the Android Debug Bridge one), if Dana should control it.
settings.label: TV
settings.name: tv_entity

settings.description: ADB command that tunes the TV to a channel, with {channel} in it (e.g. your TV provider app's deep link); unset: no channel changes
settings.help: Optional, for changing channels: a command with {channel} where the number goes.
settings.label: TV channel command
settings.name: tv_channel_command
